verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar is documented to screen every payment attempt synchronously as part of the charge/PaymentIntent flow, producing a risk_level/risk_score that determines block/allow/review outcomes in real time, and test cards exist to simulate specific risk levels (docs-5, docs-20, docs-27, docs-6). However, the evidence pack never shows a standalone, explicitly synchronous 'get risk score before authorization' API call with a documented request/response schema exposing the numeric score directly to developers outside the charge object — it's implied via risk_level on the charge rather than a dedicated scoring endpoint. Community reports also note friction with programmatic control over outcomes (comm-2). Missing for 10: a dedicated synchronous risk-scoring endpoint/response schema independent of charge creation, clearer documentation of the exact score field and timing guarantee, and independent hands-on confirmation of real-time synchronous scoring latency.
